g.title: HR_Z_IMPORTPAYLOADS
g.text: Payload Staging Table - Payload staging table: it contains the imported payloads for a given entity.
Payload expressed as an XML document.
Payload processing status. Possible values: I - inserted; X - executed.
Company where the Employee is moved to.
Effective start date after the move.
JSON data structure indicating a status for each entity in a payload coming from Zucchetti. Possible values: I - inserted; X - executed; E - Error.
Indicates the date and time of creation
Indicates the IP address from which it was created
Indicates the date and time of last update operation
Indicates the user who has executed last update
Indicates the IP address from which was executed last update
Indicates how many update was executed since its creation
Indicates the user who has created it

g.title: HR_Z_IMPORTHEADER
g.text: Staging Table - Header staging table: it contains the inbound flow definitions, along with the web service definitions and the statistics for executions.
Code identifying the entities to be imported.
Request body for the Web Service. It is a SOAP envelope containing placeholders to be replaced before invoking the web service.
Indicates that the flow is enabled to process data starting from a specific date.
Indicates that the flow is enabled to process a range of entities (chunk).
Date when the data source was last queried.
Date when the web service was last called.
Flow processing status. Possible values: R - Running; X - Executed.
Running process timestamp (NULL in quiet mode).
Running process GUID (NULL in quiet mode).
Indicates the date and time of creation
Indicates the user who has created it
Indicates the IP address from which it was created
Indicates the date and time of last update operation
Indicates the user who has executed last update
Indicates the IP address from which was executed last update
Indicates how many update was executed since its creation
